name: focus-text
title: Focus Text
description: Character-by-character text reveal that scales and sharpens into focus with replayable motion.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Pause duration after the full reveal completes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Automatically replay the animation on a loop.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Links the reveal to scroll progress instead of playing on mount. Disables looping and the replay button.

props.name: scrollStart
props.description: ScrollTrigger start value used when scrub is enabled.

props.name: scrollEnd
props.description: ScrollTrigger end value used when scrub is enabled.

props.name: showReplayButton
props.description: Shows the built-in replay button inside the component.
